findings.summary: 17 prior CLOSED cycles (m9-03..m9-18) had verify_status / release_status / archive_status all set to null. m9-19 introduced these fields but didn't backfill.
findings.resolution: For each CLOSED cycle, set verify_status='passed', release_status='released', archive_status='archived'. Values derived from the status=CLOSED fact.

findings.summary: Added cross-check #13 to vault-drift-sweep.md enforcing these three fields on CLOSED cycles.
findings.resolution: Cross-check #13 will catch any future 'new field added, no backfill' drift.
